headline: Colombia Auto Sales Projected at 335,000 Units in 2026 Before 2027 Slowdown
summary: Automotive association Andemos projects new car sales in Colombia will reach 335,000 units in 2026, but warned of an expected contraction in demand in 2027.
why: Vehicle sales serve as a barometric indicator of consumer spending power, domestic credit health, and retail activity in Colombia.

impacts.name: Colombian Automotive
impacts.why: Strong projected sales in 2026 precede an expected softening of consumer demand in 2027.
